#show outline.entry: it => context {

  if is-app {
    let loc = el.location()
    let prefix = {
      [Appendix ]
      numbering("A", counter(heading).at(loc).at(1, default: 1))
      "."
      str(counter(figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-app")).at(loc).first())
      [.]
    }
    link(loc, it.indented(prefix, it.inner()))
  } else {
    link(el.location(), it.indented(it.prefix(), it.inner()))
  }
}
